collection.description: The Essential Mix is a weekly radio show on BBC Radio 1 currently broadcast between 0:00 - 2:00 AM UK time on Saturday morning. Originally broadcast on 30 October 1993, the Essential Mix features contemporary DJs and music producers of electronic dance music. The show has been presented since its inception by Pete Tong and features an uninterrupted two-hour mix from a different artist each week, overlaid with occasional continuity announcements delivered by Tong. With a broadcast run in excess of 25 years, the Essential Mix is one of the longest-running programmes in the current BBC Radio 1 schedule, and is one of very few Radio 1 shows which is not broadcast live.

collection.description:
this ctrlz experience DJ mix opens with about 7 minutes of custom 909 drum programming played live on my Roland DJ-505 before dropping into Adam Ten’s “I Never Knew” and seeing where things go. house, garage, reggae, latin influences, bass, and familiar songs in unexpected places. multi-genre mixing with room to play and make mistakes.

featuring “I Never Knew,” “Pumped Up Kicks,” “Touch It,” “Eyes on Fire” (Michael Bibi Remix), “Funeral” (Motiv FLIP), “Business of War” (pupajim remix), and Prospa’s “Don’t Stop” x “Ayo Technology.”
ctrlz experience is a Denver, Colorado DJ and electronic music producer exploring psychedelic sounds, playful transitions, and connection through music.
cover art blends my mixer (Roland DJ 505) with a sunset photo my mom took in Gold Hill, Nevada ❤️
#ctrlzexperience
where it is okay to make mistakes.

music + bookings: https://ctrlzexperience.com
ctrlzexperience@gmail.com

user.description:
welcome to the ctrlz experience, where it is okay to make mistakes.
ctrlz experience is a Denver-based Colorado DJ, electronic music producer, KGNU 88.5 community radio DJ and dance floor curator. genre-bending sets move through house, deep house, bass, reggae, dub, indie dance and psychedelic electronic music.

from Colorado ski resorts and après parties to festivals, outdoor pop-ups, renegade parties, sunrise sets and sunset sets, ctrlz experience creates welcoming spaces for movement, freedom and connection. 

performances include Eldora, Vail and Crested Butte, with 2026 opening sets for Big Sis, Mah Ze Tar and Justin Jay.

let yourself relax and feel the omnipresent love and benevolence surrounding you.

it is your nature to be alive, aware, conscious, accepting, happy, harmless, infinite, whole and free.

let the music reveal—or remind you of—your true nature. if you get confused, relax and listen to the music play.

you are invited to embrace whatever arises and hold it in loving awareness, without judgment or attachment to the outcome.
may rhythm and dance continue to reawaken the innate joy, peace and freedom within all of us and all life.

user.description:
Hey, Gareth here, I'm a graphic designer (www.acid.works) born from the clubs, parties, and labels in the late 90s. Back then, mix CDs were the holy grail of both design and music. I loved them.

But I wasn't the only one, mix cds were the soundtracks of our nights, our days, our afterparties and lives, for everyone. Yet in today's internet age, the art form has been lost (or just changed) to 2-3 hour online mixes and streaming videos, which just don't create the same magic your CD collection did. Just 60 minutes of music and incredible artwork.

The Classic Mix CD Series celebrates these discs, their soundtrack, their box art and your memories. We hope you enjoy it.

---

Also, we try to help you find and buy them again by sharing Discogs links on all featured CDs and or direct links to labels where possible.

* We fully support labels and artists. If any disc creates a copyrighting issue let me know and it will be immediately removed. 

---

About Gareth:
Digital creative type, gamer, music lover and occasional DJ. Currently living between Dubai & Seoul after setting sail from Sunderland in 2010. As a young designer, club and music culture was the driving force for his work, producing artwork for local club nights and record labels in the North East of England. In particular, DJ mix cds and their packaging were always his 'holy grail of design', especially those from Renaissance, Global Underground and Good Looking Records. It's a pleasure to share these discs back with people and they still influence our tastes to this day. 

For any CD recommendations, bookings, mixes or feedback you can catch me as @asapgareth on Instagram. Or you can check our my design work at www.acid.works
